head.text: SPI target mode 1: split sample and shift edges; final RX bit is committed without a ninth edge

signal.name: o_spi_io_o[1] (MISO)
data: first bit valid before first SCLK edge

foot.text: Mode 1: shift on SCLK rising edges and sample on falling edges. The eighth falling edge writes the completed RX word; CS may rise immediately afterward.
